steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ check into a hotel — I’d like to check in, please. I have a reservation under…
✓ make a polite request — Could you…, please? for them, Could I…? for you
✓ say something is wrong — There’s a problem with… — and ask for it to be fixed
✓ write a short note to reception — who and where you are, the problem, the request, the close
✓ write a short message to a friend, and hear the difference in register
